title: Garuda
description: Garuda is a heavily customized, next-generation Skyrim Anniversary Edition (1.6.1170) Wabbajack modlist engineered to transform Tamriel into a modern action RPG. Combining full Physically Based Rendering (PBR) textures, neural upscaling, responsive skill-based combat, immersive survival mechanics, and massive new lands—alongside curated adult (NSFW) frameworks—Garuda delivers a cohesive, high-fidelity experience right out of the box.
author: Luthiendeon
